# PDF.js

PDF.js 6.4.299, distributed as `pdfjs-dist` by Mozilla:
https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist/v/6.4.299

Unmodified browser library, worker, character maps, and standard font data.
Licensed under Apache License 2.0; see LICENSE and the bundled font licenses.
Loaded only when a visitor selects a PDF. All document parsing happens locally.
